chunks: When the Lote-tree was covered over with what it was covered over;

key_terms.السِّدْرَة: The Lote-tree, specifically Sidrat al-Muntaha, the boundary of the seventh heaven or limit of creation.
key_terms.يَغْشَى: To cover, envelop, or overwhelm; here referring to being covered by divine light or angels.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Lote-tree of the Utmost Boundary in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the culmination of the Prophet's (SAWW) spiritual ascent, where the Lote-tree of the Utmost Boundary (Sidrat al-Muntaha) serves as the final threshold before the Divine Presence. Scholars emphasize that the 'enveloping' refers to the overwhelming manifestation of divine glory (Tajalli) that obscured the tree from full human comprehension, marking the limit of created knowledge. This event underscores the unique status of the Prophet as the perfect recipient of revelation, bridging the gap between the material and spiritual realms.
